claim.benchmark: ImageNet-C at severity 5 using entropy scores from timm vit_base_patch16_224
claim.scope: all 15 standard corruption types, a 37,500-example test stream, 10 realizations, alpha=0.05
claim.power_statement: Conditional CTM has a steeper empirical-power curve than standard CTM for moderate reference sizes n>=500.
claim.ratio_statement: The median standard-CTM/conditional-CTM rejection-time ratio tends to exceed one for the larger-shift Blur and Weather groups.

verdict_rule.VERIFIED: A full-scope reconstruction or released raw arrays reproduce both statements with independent re-aggregation and controls.
verdict_rule.FALSIFIED: An assumption-matched full-scope run contradicts either exact statement, with implementation and data identity independently checked.
verdict_rule.BLOCKED: The source data or exact protocol cannot be reconstructed, or only the plotted source figure/proxies can be checked.
